<thought>Search the template catalog using the broader functional group “halide” (instead of “alkyl halide”) while still requiring the breaking of an aliphatic hydroxyl. This should retrieve the substitution template we need.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
